about: The typesetting rule's gate (spikes/typeset-gate.mjs): the papers it runs, by set, and each paper's record it must hold. round: the evaluation round of 34 the rule was tuned on (records/typesetting.md). unseen: 13 Chinese papers the rule never saw. newLanguage: 9 papers of the round in a language they were not evaluated in. twoLayouts: Chinese 2608.02163, a two-column body and a one-column appendix. fresh: 10 of the unseen papers in Japanese, Korean, German and Russian, translated once with Microsoft's free engine (spikes/typeset-translate.mjs, 2026-10-01): the holdout that judges a change. aside: the other 3 unseen papers (every fourth from the second: 2608.09746, 2608.20847, 2608.25750) in those languages, run only with ASIDE=1, for a final judgement. Numbers only: pages against the original, start and end drift in columns, the share of blocks within 15 %, floats on their original's page and within 30 pt, per paper and as set means; image, the TeX image the record was made with.
